_comment: Карточки сетапов (знания опытных трейдеров). Это общеизвестная методология, НЕ доказанное преимущество: у каждой карточки свой тег гипотезы hyp, статистика копится в ./tb exp stats (первая неделя: цель проверка гипотез). Мозг получает 1-2 подходящие карточки в brief.playbook по сигналу и режиму; жёсткие правила entry_scout и guard выше карточек. Поля: id, setup (из SETUPS), side, kinds (виды сигналов скана или news:<класс>), regimes (пусто = любой), when, stop, target, inval, avoid (каждое до 120 символов), rr (минимальный брутто RR), hyp.

cards.when: Price pokes through a daily/prior/swing level, then a 5m candle closes back beyond it: trade the reclaim on that close (confirm candle).
cards.stop: Beyond the poke extreme plus 0.1%, outside the wick.
cards.target: Next level on the other side, then the one after.
cards.inval: 5m close back through the level against you.
cards.avoid: Entry candle already more than 1 ATR(5m) from the level (chase).

cards.when: Price takes an obvious high/low (liquidity sweep, often with a liquidation cascade) and closes back inside within 1-3 candles: trade against the sweep.
cards.target: Range midpoint, then the opposite boundary.
cards.inval: Second close beyond the swept extreme.
cards.avoid: Trend continuing with expanding volume after the sweep (it was a breakout).

cards.when: Range regime: fade the boundary (short near resistance, long near support) with a rejection candle.
cards.target: Range midpoint, then the opposite boundary.
cards.inval: Two 5m closes outside the boundary, or the regime turns trend/storm.
cards.avoid: BTC trending hard; a boundary already touched 3+ times (weakened).

cards.when: A level breaks on a volume surge: do not chase, enter on the first retest of the broken level that holds (candle confirm), in the break direction.
cards.stop: Back inside the old range, beyond the retest low/high.
cards.target: Measured move (range height) or the next level.
cards.inval: 5m close back inside the old range.
cards.avoid: Break on thin volume (turn_surge_5m < 2) or straight into an opposite level.

cards.when: With the 1h trend (EMA20 vs EMA50, r4h same sign) buy pullbacks to a level in an uptrend, sell rallies in a downtrend; confirm candle at the level.
cards.target: Prior swing extreme, then the next daily/weekly level.
cards.inval: 1h structure breaks (lower low in an uptrend, higher high in a downtrend).

cards.when: Open interest dropped hard while price moved: positions were flushed and the move is often exhausted. Wait for the lost level to be reclaimed, trade the reclaim.
cards.target: The level where the flush started, then the midpoint.
cards.inval: New extreme with open interest rising again.
cards.avoid: Entering inside the flush candle itself.

cards.when: OI up with flat price is a crowded build, direction unknown: wait for the range break with a confirm candle and trade the break against the crowded side (funding sign shows who).
cards.inval: No break within 60 minutes: skip, the setup is dead.

cards.when: Funding extreme: the crowded side pays. Only trade the reversal from resistance (funding > 0) or support (funding < 0) with a rejection candle, never on funding alone.
cards.target: Midpoint of the range, then the next level.
cards.inval: Close beyond the level on volume.
cards.avoid: Strong trend with funding rising for days; any entry without a level.

cards.when: One-sided liquidation cascade (liq_side long = longs wiped, price fell) often marks local exhaustion: after the cascade candle closes, trade the reclaim of the swept level.
cards.target: The pre-cascade level, then the midpoint.
cards.inval: A second cascade wave in the same direction.
cards.avoid: Entering inside the cascade candle; storm regime.

cards.when: Price drifts one way while aggressive flow (CVD) goes the other: the move is unsupported or absorbed. Trade the reversal only from a level with a rejection candle, never on CVD alone.
cards.target: The level the drift started from, then the midpoint.
cards.inval: CVD turns to agree with price and the level breaks on volume.
cards.avoid: Thin flow, a news window, or a trend day where dips keep being bought.

cards.when: A large wall that has stood 30+ seconds near price (bid = support, ask = resistance) can defend a level. Enter only after price tests the wall and rejects with a candle.
cards.stop: Just beyond the wall (a few ticks past it).
cards.target: The opposite wall or the next level.
cards.inval: The wall is pulled or eaten (size collapses): the idea is dead, exit.
cards.avoid: Walls that appear and vanish (spoof); a wall far from a real level.

cards.when: Listing news: the first spike is usually priced in within minutes. Do not buy it; wait for the first pullback that holds a level, size small.
cards.inval: Lower low than the first pullback.
cards.avoid: move_pct already large or age_s above 600.

cards.when: Hack, delisting or regulation news: check it is not priced in (move_pct against the stop distance). Short only from a bounce into a level with a rejection candle, never by headline.
cards.inval: Reclaim of the pre-news level (the news is absorbed).
cards.avoid: Coin already down 10% in minutes; thin book.

cards.when: Macro print or ETF news: price jumps, then often mean-reverts. Skip the first 5-15 minutes; trade BTC only from a level with a confirm candle after volatility settles.
cards.target: The nearest level on the other side.
cards.avoid: Any entry inside the print candle.
